title: «اسب وحشی نهم»؛ نقدی تند به سیا که می‌تواند تماشاگران آمریکایی را دو قطبی کند

title: Araghchi stresses need for a responsible response from Islamic countries regarding violation of Iran's sovereignty
body: Tehran, IRNA – In a telephone conversation with the new Secretary-General of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi emphasized the need for Islamic countries to respond responsibly to the violation of Iran's sovereignty and territorial integrity, and to counter the use of force and aggression.

title: Iran: Calls for unconditional IAEA Safeguards compliance meaningless
body: London, IRNA – Iran’s mission to the United Nations in Vienna says calls on Tehran to unconditionally comply with International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) Safeguards are “meaningless” under the current “hazardous” circumstances.

title: Iran on path of active deterrence: A new defense doctrine with new tools
body: Tehran, IRNA – The unveiling of the Qasem Basir ballistic missile marks a turning point in Iran's defense strategy; it is a missile that not only boasts greater range and precision but also symbolizes a paradigm shift: the transition from reactive to active deterrence.

title: Iran: US and Israeli regime bombed IAEA Statute and nuclear safety rules
body: London, IRNA – At the meeting of the IAEA Board of Governors, the Islamic Republic of Iran condemned the aggression by the United States and the Israeli regime against the country's peaceful, safeguards-subjected nuclear facilities, emphasizing that through these attacks, the aggressors bombed the UN Charter, the IAEA Statute, and fundamental nuclear safety rules.
